what: The published Amplify portal, built from the design files in app/ by tools/build_site.py

checks.what: no email address in any tracked text file: contact is by the issue form only (owner's rule, 3 November 2026)
no deck or film in the repository unless the owner says so for that piece (owner's rule); this portal has none
no blueprint or input file (uploads/, scraps/, scratch/, bp/, extract/, office documents, PDFs): they are not kept once their features are built (owner's rule, 8 November 2026)
every portal file is the source artifact's bytes: present, and its SHA-256 matches tools/sources.json (copies are made on the server, never retyped; a retyped copy is how a page silently drifts)

the petition snapshot is dated: tools/sources.json records the summary's own fetched date, and they agree; the file must also name its source (a summary made from Parliament's record; R5 was first written against an assumed raw-record shape, data.attributes.updated_at, before the file was seen: 9 November 2026) (the estate review's open action for this portal: "Date the petition snapshot on the page")
every relative src/href in the pages resolves to a tracked file (a page that loads a missing file is broken)

the public entry page (index.html at the root, served by GitHub Pages) opens the built portal in site/, never the unbuilt design in app/, and never names itself as a UK Youth Parliament service (D22; vaccinated against a redirect to app/ and a UKYP title)
the checks lint the Python (Ruff) and JavaScript (ESLint) and fail on any finding (D24; vaccinated against a checks workflow without the lint step)

while readiness gate G06 (a named safeguarding lead and procedure) is not passed, no issue form recruits young people for research or as ambassadors: the contact form offers no research, design crit or working group sign-up but keeps "Withdraw my research contribution", no ambassador form (or its Under 13 option) is in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, nothing links to one, and G06's note says what is paused (defect D25)

no readiness gate still waits on a pull request that the repository's history shows merged (defect D28: G19 stayed Open after pull request 5 was merged); needs full history, and says so on a shallow clone
generated documents agree in number: no "1 Must gates" or "1 ... gates open" (defect D29: the go-live verdict read "1 Must gates open" when one gate was left)

people decide the irreversible: no GitHub workflow merges, pushes, force-pushes, deletes a branch, repository or release, publishes a release or a site, or asks for write access to contents (vaccinated against a workflow that runs gh pr merge)

site/ is exactly what tools/build_site.py makes from app/ today: rebuilt into a temporary folder with the same build date, every file's SHA-256 matches (a hand edit to site/ is how a page drifts from its design)

no design-time drop-zone ships: no <image-slot> element, no "Drop the …" placeholder, no image-slot runtime (the design's six drop-zones would have shown "Drop the UKYP or partner logo" to the public)
the usual footer is on the portal: Disclaimers, Disclosures, Transparency, Contact, the contact form link, and the barcode and QR colophon (owner's rule: the usual footer on published artefacts)
no email address and no mailto: anywhere in site/: contact is by the contact form only (owner's rule, 3 Nov 2026)
the page says it is unofficial in all three places a reader can land: the splash, the masthead and the footer (the design names UKYP throughout; without this it reads as UKYP's own service)
every relative src/href in a site page resolves to a file in site/

nothing loads from a host a published artifact blocks: scripts only from the allowed CDNs, stylesheets only from Google Fonts, no remote image or tile (the design's map loaded a stylesheet from unpkg and street tiles from CARTO, and the CARTO tiles now return "API key required" images: found 15 November 2026)
site/build.json lists every file in site/ with the SHA-256 it has
nothing in a site page reaches another host before the visitor clicks: no external script, stylesheet, preconnect or font (defect D5: the design told unpkg and Google every visitor's IP address)
CHANGELOG.md, docs/registers.md and docs/research/ are exactly what tools/make_docs.py writes from data/ (no hand-kept copy)

every drawer screen has a tooltip and explainer in data/tooltips.json, and every term or control tooltip the page names (data-tip="term:..." or "ui:...") exists, so no tooltip is ever empty (owner's request, 15 Nov 2026)

the service design hangs together: every explainer persona has a service-design persona and the reverse, every story, journey stage and persona names a real persona and drawer screen, every story is proved by a real check id, and every blueprint layer has one cell per phase (UCD artefacts must not drift from the portal)

accuracy guards on what the page claims: no other organisation linked inside the UK Youth Parliament's name (D13), votes at 16 never stated as law while the Bill is before Parliament (D14), and the splash's typed manifesto line always credited as Amplify's own words, not a quotation (D15)

go-live readiness is honest: every passed or partial gate names evidence that is a real check (or a named workflow), every gate not passed names who must act, and every open item it cites exists in the registers

every new word is in the glossary, thesaurus, knowledge graph and tooltips at once: each glossary term is in a release, written into the built graph and list, links only to real nodes, and every tooltip term has an entry
the product backlog and roadmap trace to real screens and real checks, and the alerts strip, Share button and a pausable, reduced-motion-safe news ticker are on the page

the privacy promise matches what the pledge form does: no "no name" claim while it asks for one, the name box says it is optional and saved only on this device, a "Clear my pledges from this device" control removes the pledges from storage, and every browser-storage access sits inside try/catch (defect D27)

while readiness gate G06 (a named safeguarding lead and procedure) is not passed, nothing on the portal invites a young person to sign up for research or as an ambassador: no sign-up link, the pause and its reason are on both screens and in the data, and the route to withdraw a research contribution stays (defect D25)

campaign art follows Brand & style: every Campaign kit asset exists, never uses the Caution hue (25), embeds the portal's own fonts (an SVG shown as an image cannot load web fonts), and the kit's posts carry no emoji or exclamation marks (defects D30 and D31, 16 November 2026; the guide's voice rule); and the kit offers one graphics pack holding every asset plus the platform sizes, linked from the screen (D32: the kit had no pack); every film listed exists with its poster frame and a transcript, and none plays by itself
every CDN file the design runtime would fetch is mapped to the portal's own copy in window.__resources
every source is well formed: unique id, a known theme, nations and audiences, a V/S/K provenance, an https link, a checked date and a review cadence (a card with no date cannot say how sure it is)
every update is dated, categorised, sourced with an https link and has a provenance

nothing is past its review date: each data set and each source is checked within its cadence; past 1.5 times the cadence it fails (defect D3: a closed helpline stayed listed because nothing asked for a re-check)
no retired service is offered anywhere in site/ or the data, except where an update explains it closed (defects D3 and D4: HOPELINE247 and The Mix's old phone line)
helplines are re-checked at least every 30 days, and every helpline names how to contact it
every framework has a known status; every K (background knowledge) entry is covered by an open-register item
every nation of the UK has at least one nation-specific source, so coverage is pan-UK, not England by default

every screen in the drawer has a content-integrity class, Sample, Model and Generated screens say why, and the known sample content (the seed pledges, the sample profile) is classified as Sample (owner's rule, 15 Nov 2026: flag dummy and synthetic content explicitly)
(online only) every link answers: 2xx or 3xx, or a 401/403/405/429 from a host that refuses robots, which is reported, not failed
every screen opens with no script error and no request to another host
no screen overflows sideways at 320 px (WCAG reflow, a small phone), 768 px (a tablet) or 1440 px (a laptop)
axe-core finds no serious or critical accessibility issue beyond the recorded baseline for that screen; the baseline is the original design's own findings (open item O3) and may only shrink
the self-reporting screens fill from their data: Trusted sources shows cards, Portal health shows a status

the splash is safe to land on: it is a labelled dialog, Tab stays inside it, Escape enters the portal and moves focus to the main content, it never closes by itself once someone has interacted, and it fits a 320 px phone and a 768 px tablet without sideways scrolling (D16; vaccinated against a splash with no keyboard handling)

the light theme passes axe-core with no serious or critical issue beyond the baseline on a sample of screens, and the page renders on a phone-class CPU (4x slowdown) within the stated budget, reported every run

the drawer scrolls on its own within the screen's height without moving the page (D17), and campaign artwork opens in an in-page viewer with Print, Save and Close that Escape closes, returning focus (D18; vaccinated against a drawer with no scroll of its own)
tooltips work: hovering a drawer item shows its explainer, keyboard focus on a term links it with aria-describedby, and Escape closes it (vaccinated against a page with no tooltip layer)

the news ticker, alerts, Share and product screens behave: the ticker is a labelled list of links that its button pauses (and says so), that stands still under reduced motion with no duplicate read out; an alert can be dismissed; Share opens a menu with a copy option when the device has no share sheet; the backlog filter narrows the list; and turning the ticker off on Alerts & notifications removes it (vaccinated against a ticker that keeps moving after its pause button is pressed)
